_note: Neon Realtime has no permissions file: read rules are the filters of the server's sealed SQL queries (src/lib/live-queries.server.ts), write rules are checks in the server's write handlers (src/lib/mutators.server.ts) and the member route, plus the composite foreign keys and unique indexes in the SQL, so they count as server and schema, as in the other Neon ports. src/roles.ts (the role table the UI reads, and the handlers too) stays under permissions, as in the Jazz copy. src/fixtures.ts (createFixture) feeds the demo-data route, counted as server. scripts/, neon.ts (config) and harness.mjs are bench plumbing.
